description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Backend Engineer to build and scale the backend of a high-traffic gaming companion platform with over 25 million monthly visits.
The mandatory requirements include 3+ years of backend development with TypeScript on Node.js, strong SQL and caching skills, experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, production-scale applications, daily hands-on use of AI coding tools, and an upper-intermediate English level.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Build and maintain REST and GraphQL APIs in TypeScript (Fastify, Hono) for user profiles, subscriptions and game data, including authentication, rate limits and typed contracts.
- Design schemas and write queries for PostgreSQL and MySQL (Prisma, Drizzle), including versioned game data, player builds and migrations on tables in live use.
- Run ClickHouse analytics pipelines: request logs, materialized views, article and revenue metrics, and the queries behind dashboards.
- Own the cache layers end to end: Redis-compatible stores, query caching, tag-invalidated cache, HTTP headers and CDN purges.
- Build and run scheduled jobs and queue consumers (NATS) for game data sync, leaderboards, Meilisearch indexing, sitemaps, Stripe webhooks, payouts and data-deletion requests.
- Integrate third-party APIs (Stripe, Discord, Blizzard, IGDB, Steam, YouTube), handling retries, backoff and rate limits.
- Process game images into map tiles, sprite sheets and responsive image sizes.
- Keep responses lean for Remix and Next.js pages to improve time to first byte, PageSpeed and SEO.
- Work with AI coding agents every day: direct them, review their output, and maintain the guardrails that make their changes safe to merge (tests, lint rules, build checks, agent instructions).
- Deploy through Docker, GitHub Actions and Kubernetes.
- Support high-traffic game launches, including outside regular hours when needed.

MUST HAVES
- 3+ years of backend development with TypeScript on Node.js.
- Strong command of TypeScript’s type system (generics, inference, discriminated unions, narrowing).
- Schema validation experience with Zod or similar.
- Strong SQL skills in PostgreSQL and/or MySQL: schema design, indexing, query plans, migrations on live data, transactions and locking.
- Experience running an analytical database at production volume (ClickHouse preferred; BigQuery, Druid or similar also count).
- Experience designing caching: Redis or a compatible store, invalidation strategies, HTTP cache headers, CDN behavior.
- Experience designing and consuming REST and GraphQL APIs, including authentication and rate limiting.
- Experience with background jobs and message queues, including handling jobs that run twice or don’t run at all.
- Experience with high-volume, user-facing production applications.
- Experience taking a product from idea to production.
- Proficiency with agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar): daily, hands-on use in a real codebase, and good judgment about when their output needs checking.
- Comfortable reading and changing React code when a feature reaches the frontend.
- Able to work well in a startup-style, fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
- Flexible about working hours: some game launches happen in the evening or on weekends and need coverage outside the standard 9-to-5.
- Passion for gaming.
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Experience with Bun.
- Experience with any of the current stack: Remix, Next.js, Fastify, Hono, Prisma, Drizzle, Apollo GraphQL, Meilisearch, NATS, Ory, Stripe, Nx.
- shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS.
- Strict lint setups (typescript-eslint strictTypeChecked, custom lint rules, architecture boundaries).
- Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps (ArgoCD), GitHub Actions, External Secrets.
- Payments and subscriptions (Stripe checkout, webhooks, promotion codes).
- Writing agent instructions, skills or custom tooling for AI coding agents.
- Experience building game tools, such as databases, interactive maps, calculators or planners.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Meet Our Recruitment Process
Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview
Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.
If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.
